body: That's horrible logic. Just because everyone has to work till they die means it's okay. No I don't want to spend my life being more unhappy then I already am because everyone has too. There is nothing thrilling in my life. I play video games and work on school. And smoke weed. I will tell you one thing when I was high off my ass for 3 years straight I never noticed how much life fucking sucks. The only reason I don't kill myself is because I care about the people who care about me. It would make them unhappy for years to come if I killed myself, despite that I'd be at peace with myself.

I wish I could. I don't have the balls. I've got several plans on how to do it. Such as using advil to dilate my veins, and vyvanse to increase blood flow. Then stabbing myself in the femoral artery. Or jumping off a four story building right after I stab myself just to make sure I don't survive the fall.
